rationale: The material prompt requirement is From a nucleotide FASTA containing hepatitis C accessions, assign genotype and closest within-genotype subtype using sequence comparison only. For each record, assess coverage of the three supplied antiviral-target amino-acid windows and produce separate accession-level CSV outputs by target region.. At # HCV all-sequence non-COMET coverage audit, the source is scoped to Assign non-COMET HCV genotype and closest within-genotype subtype for every record in an all.fasta-style nucleotide FASTA, then report overlap with NS3 positions 36-175, NS5A positions 26-93, and NS5B positions 150-321. Use when an accession-level coverage table is needed from an HCV sequence collec; that source-visible scope directly supplies the required workflow and outputs without a material unsupported component.
